100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 19, 1926, the U.S. continued to grapple with Prohibition, as debates intensified over the effectiveness of the ban on alcohol. In England, the General Strike loomed as miners faced worsening conditions and labor tensions escalated. Meanwhile, in Germany, the political landscape remained turbulent following the fallout from the Treaty of Versailles, with rising concerns about the stability of the Weimar Republic.
